# Config reference (generated)

> Generated by `npm run docs:generate:config` from `domain/config/schema.js`. Values are defaults before repo config.

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `section` | `""` | Legacy alias for mode.promptSection: replaces the whole Tower-mode system prompt text. |
| `allowAgentControl` | `` | Legacy alias for mode.allowAgentControl: register tower_control so the model may toggle the mode. |
| `init.autoGitInit` | `false` | tower_init may run git init and create an empty initial commit when the directory is not a repository. |
| `init.snapshotDirty` | `false` | tower_init may snapshot uncommitted tracked changes into a dangling commit used as the mission baseline. |
| `init.autoExclude` | `true` | Add in-repo Tower artifacts (MISSIONS.md, in-repo worktree roots) to .git/info/exclude so they do not look like user dirt. |
| `mode.promptSection` | `` | Replacement Tower-mode system prompt text. Empty keeps the built-in reminder. |
| `mode.sectionAppend` | `` | Extra text appended to the Tower-mode system prompt section (team conventions). |
| `mode.allowAgentControl` | `true` | Register tower_control so the model may enter/leave the mode with a reason. |
| `mode.autoPauseGoal` | `true` | Pause an active goal when entering Tower mode. |
| `mode.requireResumeAuthorization` | `false` | Require an authorization reference when resuming a mission paused with pauseCause=user. |
| `mode.requireHumanAckOnFirstEntry` | `false` | Require a human /tower ack before the model may enter Tower mode for the first time in a session. |
| `mode.workspaceLock` | `false` | Allow only one Tower session per repository (advisory <git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/tower.lock). |
| `mode.workspaceLockScope` | `"all"` | all = every repo-scoped tool acquires the workspace lock; mutations = only tools that write state/worktrees do. |
| `mode.planModePolicy` | `"clear"` | On Tower entry: clear an active plan mode, or refuse to enter until the plan is exited. |
| `mode.workspaceStaleMs` | `300000` | A workspace lock older than this is stale and can be taken over. |
| `mode.heartbeatMs` | `10000` | Workspace-lock heartbeat interval while Tower mode is on. |
| `mode.denyTools` | `["create_goal","todo_write","team_task_create","team_task_update","team_task_reopen","team_task_list","spawn_teammate","wait_agent","workflow","ralph","subagent","subagent_fork"]` | Tools refused while Tower mode is active. |
| `mode.storePath` | `` | Directory for modes.json; defaults to $DSH_HOME/tower-mode. |
| `mode.maxEntries` | `200` | Maximum persisted mode entries. |
| `mode.lockTimeoutMs` | `5000` | How long saveModes waits for the cross-process modes.lock before giving up. |
| `review.requireReview` | `false` | Require an independent clean review before merge. Default false: review is optional; set true to enforce the review gate globally. |
| `review.maxRoundsPerReviewer` | `5` | Review-round cap per reviewer per mission branch. |
| `merge.timeoutMs` | `900000` | Default tower_merge timeout, including pre-merge hooks. |
| `merge.maxBufferBytes` | `67108864` | Captured merge output buffer. |
| `git.timeoutMs` | `15000` | Default timeout for Git commands other than merge; merge uses merge.timeoutMs. |
| `worktrees.root` | `` | Default parent directory for mission worktrees; empty derives <main-checkout-parent>/.dsh-tower-worktrees/<hash>. |
| `spawn.workerPreset` | `"tower-worker"` | Agent preset for worker missions. |
| `spawn.reviewerPreset` | `"tower-reviewer"` | Agent preset for reviewers. |
| `spawn.maxDepth` | `1` | Subagent depth requested when spawning tower agents. |
| `spawn.provider` | `` | Subagent provider id; empty picks spawn, then the first registered provider. |
| `spawn.workerModel` | `{}` | Model route for workers; omitted inherits the parent session. |
| `spawn.reviewerModel` | `{}` | Model route for reviewers; omitted inherits the parent session (recommended). |
| `spawn.maxLiveWorkers` | `4` | Maximum live worker entries allowed per repository at once. |
| `spawn.staleMs` | `15000` | Roster entries with no catalog activity after this age are marked stale and block merge (0 disables). |
| `spawn.maxWaitMs` | `90000` | Upper bound for tower_spawn waitMs (default 90s, Kimi-compatible). |
| `spawn.requireLease` | `` | Optional lease name tower_spawn must hold before starting a worker. |
| `send.maxPerMinute` | `120` | Per-repository tower_send rate limit per minute (0 disables). |
| `send.interruptDefault` | `false` | Default value of tower_send.interrupt when the caller omits it. |
| `tests.enabled` | `true` | Run declared test discovery when a mission configures it. |
| `tests.admission` | `"off"` | Run discovery before spawning a worker, when completing, or only on explicit tower_test (default off: repository code runs only on an explicit tower_test). |
| `tests.timeoutMs` | `60000` | Per discovery command timeout. |
| `tests.maxBytes` | `16777216` | Maximum captured stdout bytes per command. |
| `tests.autoChecks` | `true` | Attach a tests check to the completion report when discovery runs. |
| `tests.allowPackageDiscovery` | `true` | Allow package.json tower.testDiscovery commands from the mission worktree (executes repository code; see security docs). |
| `gates.requireChecks` | `false` | Require at least one completion check (tower_complete.checks) before a mission can merge. |
| `gates.requireTests` | `false` | Require a passing test-discovery receipt for the reviewed worktree tip before merge. |
| `gates.allowReviewExemption` | `false` | Allow reviewPolicy:none missions with a non-empty reviewExemptionReason to skip review blockers. |
| `docs.board` | `true` | Write a human-readable MISSIONS.md after mission changes. |
| `docs.boardLocation` | `"common"` | common = <git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/MISSIONS.md; repo = <repoRoot>/MISSIONS.md. |
| `tools.exposeOperational` | `true` | Master switch for batch/resource/import/legacy/recover/test/doctor tools. |
| `tools.exposeBatch` | `true` | Register tower_batch. |
| `tools.exposeImport` | `true` | Register tower_import_legacy/tower_legacy_map. |
| `tools.exposeLeases` | `true` | Register tower_resource advisory leases. |
| `tools.exposeTests` | `true` | Register tower_test; gates.requireTests requires it. |
| `tools.exposeRecovery` | `true` | Register tower_recover (stale state-lock escape). |
| `tools.exposeDoctor` | `true` | Register tower_doctor (read-only health contract). |
| `leases.ttlMs` | `900000` | Default advisory lease lifetime; expiry never auto-releases. |
| `dev.hotReload` | `true` | Register tower_reload and /tower reload when the DSH HMR service is available. |
| `dev.reloadDelayMs` | `50` | Delay before a scheduled reload, so the tool result is delivered first. |
| `dev.reloadRequiredIds` | `["tower-bundle","tower","tower-skills","preset-tower-worker","preset-tower-reviewer"]` | Loader entry ids passed to reconcileProfile as required. |
